context: A police officer briefs on security
purpose: Teach: 立ち入り/来客/注釈/痕跡/痕/に当たる/成っ/時として

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 立ち入り規制、警察基準で、再確認をお願いします。
lines.en: Please re-confirm access restrictions against our police standards.
lines.style: Measured and official. Steady eye contact. Clear enunciation on each key term. No rush — the words carry their own weight. Professional courtesy underlying the authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来客時の警備、強化します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen security protocols for visitors.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Slight forward lean. Earnest — taking the instruction seriously without over-performing. Quiet confidence that the work will be done.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 不正アクセスの注釈、契約書に明記してください。
lines.en: Unauthorized access protocols need to be explicitly stated in the contract.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. Slight tap of emphasis on 'explicitly'. Not unkind, but non-negotiable. The tone of someone who has seen what happens when things aren't spelled out.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。痕跡を残す対策、社内で進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll move forward internally on trace-retention measures.
lines.style: Businesslike, taking notes mentally. Respectful pace. Shows he's absorbing, not just receiving. Demonstrates competence through attention to detail.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 過去事件の痕、警察データベースで、共有可能です。
lines.en: Past incident data is available for sharing through our police database.
lines.style: Straightforward procedural information. Slight pause before the offer — giving weight to the resource being made available. Calm authority, no pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法改正に当たる時期、対応を急ぎます。
lines.en: Yes. When legal revisions come up, we'll prioritize updating our procedures.
lines.style: Responsive and proactive. Nods slightly with the acknowledgment. Shows he understands the stakes. Quick but not rushed — demonstrating readiness without rushing assurance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社、健全に成っていますね。
lines.en: Your company has been handling this responsibly.
lines.style: Genuine approval delivered without warmth. A brief acknowledgment of competence — the kind compliment that matters because it's earned, not given. Slight nod.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。時として、警察への通報も、検討します。
lines.en: Yes. We're also prepared to report concerns to police when necessary.
lines.style: Settling into agreement. Quiet resolution. The finality of 'also prepared' — showing alignment of values, not just compliance. Steady, grounded finish.
